scope: Frozen primary elapsed128 L1 scores; all 5 pools, all 3 cohorts. No training, exclusions, threshold changes or deployment claims. UR3 PCA/IF category counts use frozen original metrics.
roc: All distinct score threshold blocks, >= threshold for displayed finite ROC vertices, (0,0) included; preserve ties. Deploy predictions remain score > frozen rank calibration threshold. Full AUC uses trapezoids (tie half-credit). At b=.05,.10 report maximal observed TPR among vertices FPR<=b, without interpolation; normalized partial step area integrates right-continuous upper staircase from 0 to b / b, no randomization. Separately named linear partial AUC/b uses straight lines between threshold vertices including tied blocks. No test ROC threshold feeds deployment. UR3 normals=12: grid 0,1/12,...; below5% only zero-alarm points supported.
categories: All UR3 labelled event categories, detected/support at unchanged alpha .05 calibration thresholds; no duration/mechanism attribution.
normal_diagnostics: calibration and test normal score ECDF/quantiles only. Fitting NN scores may self-match and are excluded from generalization comparison; record self-zero counts without using them as representative nominal scores. No causal shift diagnosis, population p-values or deployment guarantees.
